items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: And then I went with Joe Robichaud. And stayed there until we changed the name of the band to John Lunsford.

ctx.x: How long did you stay with Sidney Desvien?
Oh, until the first part of 34. And then I went with Joe Robichaud. And stayed there until we changed the name of the band to John Lunsford.
See, were you on any of those records that Joe Robichaud made? I forget now.
